command.label: Command
command.hint: Update a price, ask about a fact, or ask for a summary.

confirm.title: Confirm this change?
confirm.impactNone: This change does not affect any other draft or content.
confirm.staffNote: You cannot verify this information: if you confirm, it is sent to the owner as a suggestion and nothing changes yet.

cancelContent.title: Cancel this item?
cancelContent.consequence: If you cancel, this item will not be published, and its pending approval or schedule is cancelled too.

clarify.which_value: Which amount did you mean by “{{raw}}” ({{label}})?
clarify.which_content: I found {{count}} items. Which one did you mean?

msg.fact_not_usable: {{label}} cannot be used right now ({{stateLabel}}). Verify it first under Business information.
msg.fact_unchanged: {{label}} is already {{display}}. No change was needed.
msg.fact_proposed: Your suggestion of {{new_display}} for {{label}} was sent to the owner. Nothing changes until it is accepted.
msg.brand_voice_proposed: Your brand voice suggestion was sent to the owner. Nothing changes until it is accepted.
msg.fact_changed_meanwhile: The information changed while you were confirming, so it was not updated. Check the current value and give the command again.
msg.activity_summary: {{periodLabel}} · messages: {{inbound_messages}}, conversations: {{conversations}}, replies sent: {{replies_sent}} (automatic {{replies_auto}}, after approval {{replies_approved}}, written by you {{replies_by_owner}}), handed to you: {{escalations}}, needing attention now: {{attention_now}}.
msg.value_unreadable: I could not read “{{raw}}” as a value ({{label}}). Try something like “7,000 TL”.
msg.brand_voice_missing: There is no brand voice yet. Add it under Business information.
msg.failed: The command could not be completed.
msg.draft_created: Draft “{{title}}” created ({{typeLabel}}). The text is being prepared; open it when it is ready and pick a time.
msg.content_cancelled: “{{title}}” was cancelled{{whenPart}}. It will not be published.
msg.content_changed_meanwhile: The item changed while you were confirming, or can no longer be cancelled, so it was not cancelled. Check its current status.
msg.reply_failure_title: Why a reply was not delivered
msg.no_failure: No item has failed or been put on hold.
msg.reference_not_found: I could not find the item you mean. Give its date or title, or pick it in Content.
msg.draft_unreadable: I could not tell what the draft should be about. For example, say “Prepare a story for the trial class”.
msg.failureRetryAt: It will be tried again at {{time}}.
msg.failureFinal: It will not be retried automatically.

unsupported.title: This is not something I can do yet

reason.publish: Publishing a post cannot be done by command. Do it yourself under Content.
reason.send_message: Sending a customer message cannot be done by command. Reply from the Inbox.
reason.approve: Approving and rejecting cannot be done by command. Use the buttons on the approval card.
reason.manage_account: Connecting or disconnecting accounts cannot be done by command. Use Settings.
reason.settings: Automation settings cannot be changed by command. Use Settings.
reason.members: Team members cannot be managed by command. Use Settings.
reason.other: I did not understand that, or it cannot be done by command.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.intro: What needs your decision is here. Nothing happens without your approval.
approvals.emptyHint: When you give a command, the changes that need your confirmation appear here.
approvals.emptyHistory: No approval has been decided yet

detail.title: Approval details
detail.impactNone: It does not affect anything else.

type.conversation_needs_human: A conversation needs your own reply
type.reply_failed: A reply could not be sent
type.content_on_hold_FACT_CHANGED: “{{title}}” was put on hold: business information it uses changed.
type.content_on_hold_ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE: “{{title}}” was put on hold: the Instagram account is unavailable.

extract.title: Suggest from pasted text
extract.intro: Paste your Instagram bio or price list. What is found becomes a suggestion only; nothing changes until you accept it.
extract.label: Pasted text
extract.done_one: {{count}} suggestion found. It is waiting for you.
extract.done_other: {{count}} suggestions found. They are waiting for you.
extract.none: Nothing to suggest was found in this text. You can also enter the information manually.
extract.injection: The text had parts that looked like instructions; they were ignored.
extract.failed: Suggestions could not be extracted. Your text was kept; try again or enter the information manually.
